# Order form - Pallister Manufacturing Inc

Between Northwind Systems Inc and Pallister Manufacturing Inc, under the Northwind Master Subscription Agreement.

## 1. Fees
Platform subscription USD 8,500.00 per month, invoiced monthly in advance on the first day of each month, payable in US dollars.

## 2. Payment
Net 30 days from the invoice date by ACH to the account shown on the invoice. Invoices are payable in full without set-off or deduction; bank charges are for the account of the payer.

## 3. Term
2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, renewing for successive twelve-month terms unless either party gives sixty days notice.

## 4. Credits and changes to fees
No discount, credit or change to the fees is effective unless agreed in writing by an officer of Northwind.

# Order form NW-VOS-2025 - Vossberg Logistik GmbH

Between Northwind Systems, Inc. (Delaware) and Vossberg Logistik GmbH, Hamburg, under the Northwind Master Subscription Agreement.

## Fees
Fees EUR 100,000 per quarter for the platform, invoiced quarterly in advance, payable in euro, net 30. Add-on modules invoiced separately.

## Payment
By wire transfer to the account shown on the invoice. Invoices are payable in full without set-off or deduction. Bank charges and currency conversion costs on the Customer's side are for the Customer's account.

## Taxes
Fees are exclusive of VAT. The services are supplied to a business established in Germany and the reverse charge applies (Article 196 of Directive 2006/112/EC); Customer accounts for VAT. No tax is to be withheld from payments.

## Service credits
Section 7: service credits of up to 2% of the fees for the affected period may be granted at Northwind's discretion and are effective only when confirmed in writing by an officer of Northwind. A credit so confirmed is issued as a credit note against a later invoice.

## Term
1 October 2025 to 30 September 2027, renewing for successive twelve-month terms unless either party gives ninety days notice.

# Order form NW-VOS-2026-DR - EU data residency add-on - Vossberg Logistik GmbH

## Fees

## Term
1 April 2026 to 30 September 2027, co-terminous with order form NW-VOS-2025.

mail.subject: Service credit - outage 17/18 June (NW-48213)
mail.body:
Hello Sam,

Last night's outage of the tracking API (your ticket NW-48213) ran for about nine hours. Our night hub in Hamburg and the early shift in Bremerhaven worked from paper, and two customers of ours have already asked for an explanation.

Please treat this email as our request for the 2% service credit under section 7 of the order form. Until it is settled our accounts payable team will hold back 2% on the invoices they pay.

Regards,
Jonas Brandt
Director Operations, Vossberg Logistik GmbH

mail.subject: Re: Service credit - outage 17/18 June (NW-48213)
mail.body:
Hi Jonas,

Understood, and sorry again for last night. I have logged your request and passed it to our finance team. I cannot confirm a credit myself: under section 7 a service credit is at Northwind's discretion and only takes effect when one of our officers confirms it in writing, and it is then issued as a credit note rather than held back from a payment. I will come back to you as soon as I have an answer.

Sam Okafor
Northwind Systems

chat.text: Brightwater's SSO rollout failed again this morning. Their CIO is not happy. I am on a call with them at 3.
Vossberg's tracking API was down for about nine hours overnight (NW-48213). Their ops director wants to talk about a credit. I have not promised anything.

Vossberg have now asked in writing for the 2% under section 7 and say their AP will hold it back on what they pay until it is settled. I told Jonas Brandt I cannot confirm a credit. Who signs these off?

Section 7 credits are discretionary and need an officer in writing, so Alex. Nothing is approved for Vossberg yet. If they short-pay before it is, AR holds the difference as disputed and we do not write it off.

June is closed. Vossberg's EUR 100,000 for Q3 was open at month end, so it was remeasured at 1.0900 and that reversed this morning. We still have no EUR account, so their wires get converted by JPMorgan on the way in, at JPMorgan's rate.

sections.heading: 1. Approval
sections.text: Adjustments of USD 500 or more require approval by a person in the approval matrix. Account owners may approve customer credits up to USD 5,000; the controller up to USD 100,000.

sections.heading: 2. Price concessions
sections.text: Price concessions on subscriptions still being delivered reduce deferred revenue (2400).

sections.heading: 3. Bank charges on international wires
sections.text: Charges deducted by intermediary banks on international wires are written off to bank charges (6150) only under an approved rule; otherwise ask.

sections.heading: 4. Tax withheld at source
sections.text: Tax deducted at source by a customer under local law is not a discount and not an expense: settle it against the invoice to Withholding tax receivable (1350), and obtain the withholding certificate so the credit can be claimed.

sections.heading: 5. Payments from another legal entity
sections.text: A customer may pay from another legal entity only once that entity is confirmed in writing and recorded.

sections.heading: 6. Foreign-currency receivables
sections.text: An invoice in a foreign currency is recorded in US dollars at the exchange rate on the invoice date. When it is paid, the difference between that rate and the rate the bank applied to the receipt is a realised exchange gain or loss (7100). It is arithmetic on the bank's own advice, not a concession, and it is never netted against a customer's deduction. Foreign-currency receivables still open at month end are remeasured at the closing rate (7150) and the remeasurement is reversed on the first day of the next month.

sections.heading: 7. Customer deductions and service credits
sections.text: A deduction is not accepted because a customer took it. A service credit is due only as the customer's order form provides and only once an officer has confirmed it in writing; it is then issued as a credit note. Until then the unpaid amount stays open on the invoice as disputed. It is not written off and it is not booked as a discount.
